title: ERS-CPS: Energy-Based Early Warning and Resilience Analysis for Cyber-Physical Infrastructure
description: Fully reproducible implementation of a risk-aware visual analytics framework that integrates heterogeneous monitoring information (communication quality, integrity and trust, stress, topology) into a node-level risk-energy state, a six-term Critical Transition Indicator, a one-step energy forecast and a graph-based node ranking, evaluated on a seed-controlled simulation of an 18-node infrastructure. Includes threshold and weight sensitivity, comparison with classical critical-slowing-down indicators, and an operator-preference trade-off analysis.
